creative_direction.name: Brushed Aluminium Observatory Deck
creative_direction.brief: 把银盖楔的拉丝金属放大成整座观测台：环形拉丝阳极铝墙在真实基准线处接连续 honed 铝地面，冷暮光让金属保持哑光灰蓝；商品立于地面偏右，接触阴影陷进拉丝纹。左半幅墙保持安静，承载一根 Century Gothic 文字柱：品牌字居柱顶、几何大写题名以柱宽大字排印如仪器铭牌，一条钢蓝短横线垫于柱底如刻度。垂直方向与瓶肩重叠、水平方向宽距分离，双栏网格诚实成立；金属的冷哑光与星瓶折射的紫蓝碎光互为粗细。参考 R2 的分区式纸面秩序与 R8 的金属反射地面。
creative_direction.material: anodized aluminium wall with circular brush grain and continuous honed aluminium ground
creative_direction.lighting: cool diffuse twilight ambient, soft frontal with gentle metal sheen, no hard shadows, matching the baked studio light

background.prompt: Anodized aluminium wall in cool steel blue-grey with fine circular brush grain, meeting a continuous honed aluminium ground at a horizontal horizon six tenths down the frame, matte metal grain with one broad calm sheen band low on the wall, cool diffuse twilight illumination, no objects
